status: Research design only; neither trained model nor novelty/SOTA result
coverage_limits: Two Crossref queries rate-limited; failures retained.
Top-five query results are bounded search coverage, not evidence of absence.
The DINOv3-specific wireless query did not establish whether any direct application exists; no uniqueness claim is made.
Only identified paper/code sections were reviewed, not all proofs, repositories or patents.
No weights, giant datasets, training, baseline reproduction or hardware experiment in this audit.
DINOv3 code/papers are cached outside application; only metadata, hashes and original summaries are redistributed.
causal_boundary: Current service-world random Markov blockage and Nakagami fading are not generated by visible-object motion. A CAD-image feature experiment cannot be labeled successful visual prediction of those realized hidden events; rendering labels or hidden RF coefficients as colors would leak privileged truth.
hypothesis: With matched causal RF/service history and a fixed downstream architecture, spatially grounded DINOv3 patch features add held-out-warehouse predictive/control value beyond CLS, geometry-only and RF-only inputs when visible objects actually causally affect propagation. JEPA adds value only if it beats an identical supervised encoder/controller at a declared budget.
nonclaims: Not a native electromagnetic representation guarantee
Not proof of collapse or its repair
Not a universal robot/environment or cross-band foundation model
Not architectural first-of-kind or state of the art
